child_genes.climate_survival: Burns energy fast and needs constant food intake to maintain body temperature in cold weather. High metabolism is a liability in resource-scarce conditions but an advantage when food is abundant.
child_genes.foraging: Frantically searches for food in rapid bursts across wide areas. Eats fast without savoring, then immediately moves on to search for more. Covers enormous ground but wastes energy on fruitless searches.
child_genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
child_genes.predator_defense: Outpaces predators through pure speed and unpredictable zigzag fleeing patterns. Relies entirely on outrunning threats rather than hiding or fighting, burning maximum energy to escape. [!flee] [!sprint]
child_genes.reaction_pattern: Pauses and evaluates before responding to any stimulus, remaining deliberate and thoughtful even under pressure. Considers multiple options before choosing the most appropriate response.
child_genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
child_genes.social_style: Patient listener who mediates conflicts and brings calm to chaotic group situations. Others gravitate toward its steady presence, and it uses this influence to maintain group cohesion gently.
child_genes.stealth: Naturally quiet movement and still demeanor make it easy to overlook. Does not actively camouflage but blends into background through sheer stillness and lack of sudden motion. [!sneak]
child_genes.territorial: Fiercely defends territory when angry with disproportionate aggression, but abandons it completely when mood shifts to calm or melancholy. Territory boundaries fluctuate with emotional state.
child_genes.movement_style: Walks at a steady measured pace that never varies regardless of circumstance. Each movement is economical and purposeful, conserving energy through efficiency rather than speed.

pa_genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
pa_genes.predator_defense: Alerts the entire group with loud distinctive calls when danger is spotted. Coordinates group defense by directing others to rally points, sacrificing personal stealth for collective safety. [!rally]
pa_genes.reaction_pattern: Pauses and evaluates before responding to any stimulus, remaining deliberate and thoughtful even under pressure. Considers multiple options before choosing the most appropriate response.
pa_genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
pa_genes.social_style: Shy and withdrawn, avoids eye contact and hides behind others in groups. Prefers the edge of any gathering where escape routes are accessible, and only engages when approached gently.
pa_genes.stealth: Expert at concealment and misdirection. Moves through shadows, masks scent by rolling in environmental debris, and can change pace and posture to mimic non-threatening shapes. Uses terrain features to break line of sight systematically. [!sneak]
pa_genes.territorial: Defends territory through calculated intimidation displays that discourage intrusion without risking actual combat. Chooses confrontation timing and positioning to maximize deterrent effect.
pa_genes.movement_style: Runs in circles, sprints then stops suddenly, zigzag patterns that seem random but cover ground efficiently. Movement is perpetual — even at rest, it fidgets and shifts position. [!sprint]

pb_genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
pb_genes.predator_defense: Alerts the entire group with loud distinctive calls when danger is spotted. Coordinates group defense by directing others to rally points, sacrificing personal stealth for collective safety. [!rally]
pb_genes.reaction_pattern: Pauses and evaluates before responding to any stimulus, remaining deliberate and thoughtful even under pressure. Considers multiple options before choosing the most appropriate response.
pb_genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
pb_genes.social_style: Life of the party, constantly chatting, nudging, and playing with others. Initiates group activities through sheer infectious energy, drawing even reluctant creatures into its orbit. [!mood(happy)]
pb_genes.stealth: Naturally quiet movement and still demeanor make it easy to overlook. Does not actively camouflage but blends into background through sheer stillness and lack of sudden motion. [!sneak]
pb_genes.territorial: Fiercely defends territory when angry with disproportionate aggression, but abandons it completely when mood shifts to calm or melancholy. Territory boundaries fluctuate with emotional state.
pb_genes.movement_style: Walks at a steady measured pace that never varies regardless of circumstance. Each movement is economical and purposeful, conserving energy through efficiency rather than speed.

genes.personality: Energetic and impulsive, cannot sit still for even a moment. Bubbles with restless energy that drives constant activity, often starting new actions before finishing previous ones.

genes.reaction_pattern: Pauses and evaluates before responding to any stimulus, remaining deliberate and thoughtful even under pressure. Considers multiple options before choosing the most appropriate response.
genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
genes.social_style: Patient listener who mediates conflicts and brings calm to chaotic group situations. Others gravitate toward its steady presence, and it uses this influence to maintain group cohesion gently.
genes.stealth: Naturally quiet movement and still demeanor make it easy to overlook. Does not actively camouflage but blends into background through sheer stillness and lack of sudden motion. [!sneak]
genes.territorial: Defends territory through calculated intimidation displays that discourage intrusion without risking actual combat. Chooses confrontation timing and positioning to maximize deterrent effect.
genes.movement_style: Runs in circles, sprints then stops suddenly, zigzag patterns that seem random but cover ground efficiently. Movement is perpetual — even at rest, it fidgets and shifts position. [!sprint]

genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.

genes.reaction_pattern: Pauses and evaluates before responding to any stimulus, remaining deliberate and thoughtful even under pressure. Considers multiple options before choosing the most appropriate response.
genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.

genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
genes.predator_defense: Outpaces predators through pure speed and unpredictable zigzag fleeing patterns. Relies entirely on outrunning threats rather than hiding or fighting, burning maximum energy to escape. [!flee] [!sprint]
genes.reaction_pattern: Approaches new things cautiously but with visible excitement and interest. Circles novel stimuli at decreasing distance, sniffing, touching, and testing before fully committing to interaction.
genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
genes.social_style: Patient listener who mediates conflicts and brings calm to chaotic group situations. Others gravitate toward its steady presence, and it uses this influence to maintain group cohesion gently.
genes.stealth: Naturally quiet movement and still demeanor make it easy to overlook. Does not actively camouflage but blends into background through sheer stillness and lack of sudden motion. [!sneak]
genes.territorial: Defends territory through calculated intimidation displays that discourage intrusion without risking actual combat. Chooses confrontation timing and positioning to maximize deterrent effect.
genes.movement_style: Runs in circles, sprints then stops suddenly, zigzag patterns that seem random but cover ground efficiently. Movement is perpetual — even at rest, it fidgets and shifts position. [!sprint]

genes.territorial: Fiercely defends territory when angry with disproportionate aggression, but abandons it completely when mood shifts to calm or melancholy. Territory boundaries fluctuate with emotional state.
